query.rawQuery: Why does my CS 1.6 game freeze only when I aim at players?
query.normalizedQuery: why does my cs 16 game freeze only when i aim at players

primaryItems.title: CS 1.6 Aim Freeze Symptom
primaryItems.description: Game stutter or freeze when placing crosshairs on dynamic player entities or during target rendering.

primaryItems.title: Unsynchronized Hitbox rendering & OpenGL Drivers
primaryItems.description: Legacy GoldSrc engine rendering glitches trigger frame rate drops when calculating player hitboxes on newer graphic pipelines.

claims.text: Outdated cl_minmodels settings or custom HD player models trigger severe lag spikes on rendering pipelines.
Disabling 'raw input' (m_rawinput 1) or hardware mouse acceleration causes engine polling mismatch during fast cursor movements over players.

sources.title: HackerNews CS 1.6 Aim stutter issue discussion
sources.excerpt: A thread analyzing why the GoldSrc renderer stalls when players appear on screen, highlighting custom high-polygon models and model validation routines.

sources.title: Half-Life Engine Issue Tracker #aimfreeze
sources.excerpt: Github developers pointing to dynamic lighting shader and hardware rendering buffer calculations as main causes of screen freezes when aiming at avatars.
